pandas.melt

pandas 3.1.1 · General functions · function

Keep identifier columns and turn measured columns into variable–value rows.

pd.melt(
    frame,
    id_vars=None,
    value_vars=None,
    var_name=None,
    value_name='value',
    col_level=None,
    ignore_index=True,
)
